pli-tv-bu-vb-pc62:1.1: tena samayena buddho bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc62:1.2: tena kho pana samayena chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ paribhuñjanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc62:1.3: ye te bhikkhū appicchā …pe… te ujjhāyanti khīyanti vipācenti
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc62:1.4: kathaṃ hi nāma chabbaggiyā bhikkhū jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ paribhuñjissantīti …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc62:1.5: saccaṃ kira tumhe bhikkhave jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ paribhuñjathāti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc62:1.8: hi nāma tumhe moghapurisā jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ paribhuñjissatha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc62:1.9: netaṃ moghapurisā appasannānaṃ vā pasādāya pasannānaṃ vā bhiyyobhāvāya …pe…
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc62:1.10: evañca pana bhikkhave imaṃ sikkhāpadaṃ uddiseyyātha
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc62:1.11.1: yo pana bhikkhu jānaṃ sappāṇakaṃ udakaṃ paribhuñjeyya pācittiyanti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc62:2.1.6: sāmaṃ vā jānāti aññe vā tassa ārocenti.
pli-tv-bu-vb-pc62:2.1.7: sappāṇakanti jānanto paribhogena marissantīti jānanto paribhuñjati āpatti pācittiyassa.
